svg.title: Night Signal · One exposure, one alert
svg.desc: A telescope’s gradient readout fills as it completes an exposure. A peak appears in the detector’s light curve. After comparing the exposure with a reference sky, the detector sends candidate NS-0417 to a publisher. The alert outbox gains a receipt field. The same services become sequence participants. Dashed lifelines advance as the publisher writes, the outbox publishes one alert, and a retry returns the saved receipt. The 12.6-second animation repeats.
svg.metadata: Night Signal is a seven-board D2/TALA diagram. D2 supplies the architecture, SQL row, gradient-meter states, sequence layout and message routes. This release illustration adds continuous SVG meter interpolation, the detector trace and traveling candidate, progressive lifeline clips, and the live-feed color change and count. Fonts and artwork are embedded.
